mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, device_id AS deviceId, serial_number AS serialNumber, subject_dn AS subjectDn, fingerprint_sha256 AS fingerprintSha256, certificate_pem AS certificatePem, status, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM device_certificate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND fingerprint_sha256 = #{fingerprint} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= now()) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= now()) LIMIT 1
